//: Compiles NOTHING: Node runs .ts directly, no build, no dist. This file exists only to CHECK
the types. Before it existed, `tsc --noEmit` printed the compiler's help and exited 0 — a
green that never checked a single line.
allowImportingTsExtensions is required because the code imports './users.ts' with the
extension, which is how Node actually resolves it, and not how TypeScript usually writes it.
noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters are here because ESLint does not lint TypeScript in this
project: one tool per job, and the compiler already sees more than a linter would.
